statement: For an interface triple (n, μ, ν) where n.1 ≤ 0 and plaquetteMaxTime n μ ν ≥ 0, the reflected triple also satisfies the interface condition (its base time is not > 0 and its maxTime is not < 0).
proof_code:
import YangMills.Lattice
import YangMills.SpecialUnitary
import YangMills.Proofs.LatticeMeasure
import YangMills.Proofs.BasicLemmas

open YangMills
open YangMills.Lattice
open YangMills.Proofs.LatticeMeasure
open YangMills.Proofs.BasicLemmas

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

lemma reflectTriple_preserves_interface (n : Z4Site) (μ ν : Fin 4) (h_not_pos : ¬(n.1 > 0))
    (h_not_neg : ¬(plaquetteMaxTime n μ ν < 0)) :
    ¬((reflectedPlaquetteBase n μ ν).1 > 0) ∧
    ¬(plaquetteMaxTime (reflectedPlaquetteBase n μ ν) (reflectedDir1 μ ν) (reflectedDir2 μ ν) < 0) := by
  constructor
  · -- Show reflected base time is not > 0
    by_cases hμ0 : μ = 0
    · subst hμ0
      by_cases hν0 : ν = 0
      · subst hν0
        dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectSiteSub0Sub0, reflectSite]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        have h_plaq : plaquetteMaxTime n 0 0 = n.1 + 2 := by
          dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
          omega
        rw [h_plaq] at h_not_neg
        have hn_ge_neg2 : n.1 ≥ -2 := by linarith
        nlinarith
      · have h_base : (reflectedPlaquetteBase n 0 ν).1 = -n.1 - 1 := by
          dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectSiteSub0, reflectSite]
          simp [hν0]
        rw [h_base]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        have hn_ge_neg1 : n.1 ≥ -1 := by
          have h_plaq : plaquetteMaxTime n 0 ν = n.1 + 1 := by
            dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
            simp [hν0]
          rw [h_plaq] at h_not_neg
          linarith
        nlinarith
    · by_cases hν0 : ν = 0
      · subst hν0
        dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectSiteSub0, reflectSite]
        simp [hμ0]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        have hn_ge_neg1 : n.1 ≥ -1 := by
          have h_plaq : plaquetteMaxTime n μ 0 = n.1 + 1 := by
            dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
            simp [hμ0]
          rw [h_plaq] at h_not_neg
          linarith
        nlinarith
      · dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectSite]
        simp [hμ0, hν0]
        have hn_ge0 : n.1 ≥ 0 := by
          have : plaquetteMaxTime n μ ν = n.1 := by
            dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
            simp [hμ0, hν0]
          rw [this] at h_not_neg
          linarith
        have hn_le0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hn0 : n.1 = 0 := by linarith
        simp [hn0]
  · -- Show reflected maxTime is not < 0
    by_cases hμ0 : μ = 0
    · subst hμ0
      by_cases hν0 : ν = 0
      · subst hν0
        dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectedDir1, reflectedDir2, reflectSiteSub0Sub0, reflectSite, plaquetteMaxTime]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        have h_nonneg : -n.1 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
        linarith
      · -- ν ≠ 0
        have h_eq : plaquetteMaxTime (reflectedPlaquetteBase n 0 ν) (reflectedDir1 0 ν) (reflectedDir2 0 ν) = -n.1 := by
          dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectedDir1, reflectedDir2, reflectSiteSub0, reflectSite, plaquetteMaxTime]
          have h0 : (0 : Fin 4) = 0 := by decide
          rw [h0]
          simp [hν0]
        rw [h_eq]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        nlinarith
    · by_cases hν0 : ν = 0
      · subst hν0
        dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectedDir1, reflectedDir2, reflectSiteSub0, reflectSite, plaquetteMaxTime]
        simp [hμ0]
        have hn0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra! hpos
          exact h_not_pos hpos
        have hn_ge_neg1 : n.1 ≥ -1 := by
          have : plaquetteMaxTime n μ 0 = n.1 + 1 := by
            dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
            simp [hμ0]
          rw [this] at h_not_neg
          linarith
        have : -n.1 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
        linarith
      · dsimp [reflectedPlaquetteBase, reflectedDir1, reflectedDir2, reflectSite, plaquetteMaxTime]
        simp [hμ0, hν0]
        have hn_ge0 : n.1 ≥ 0 := by
          have : plaquetteMaxTime n μ ν = n.1 := by
            dsimp [plaquetteMaxTime]
            simp [hμ0, hν0]
          rw [this] at h_not_neg
          linarith
        have hn_le0 : n.1 ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hn0 : n.1 = 0 := by linarith
        simp [hn0]
